name: M8 礁湖星云
orientation: east-left-north-up; row 0 south; columns increase west

levels.label: VPHAS+ 3.7°
levels.source: VPHAS+ DR4 Hα and r (Drew et al. 2014; ESO archive, CC BY 4.0; via CDS hips2fits)

levels.label: VPHAS+ 1°
levels.calibration: same k; scaled to the 3.7° level: R = 1.021e+1 × net + 57.8

stars.encoding: float32-le [X, Y, F550 W/m2/nm, Tcolour K]
stars.limits: Gaia G<15 within 2°, G<12.5 to 5.7°; Hipparcos V<7
stars.model: Black body at Ballesteros (2012) colour temperature from B−V (Gaia BP−RP inverted via DR3 Table 5.9), normalized to Bessell (1998) V=0 flux at 550 nm; observed (reddened) colours.

template.source: Case B Balmer ratios (Storey & Hummer 1995); [O III] 4959/5007 = 1/2.98; low-density [S II] 6716/6731 = 1.4; continuum EW(Hβ)=1370 Å (assumed). Other lines missing.

notes: 8° 底图为 SHASSA Hα（dR÷10 → R；898 个恒星残差像素用 5×5 中值替换，负值置 0）。SHASSA 的 32 Å Hα 滤镜含部分 [N II] 6548/6583，按 Hα 处理（与 7 nm Hα 滤镜的观感一致）。

细节层为 VPHAS+ CCD：Hα − k·r 扣连续谱（k = 0.4244，由 15341 个恒星像素的高通比值中位数求得），再按 SHASSA 线性定标（R = 1.022e+1×净值 + 57.8，残差 34.8 R）；1° 核心层同法按 3.7° 层定标。饱和星核与 CCD 溢出拖尾（19 / 392 个像素超过 12000 计数，沿列外扩 20″；V<7 的星另遮 30″ 圆与 ±4′ 竖条）和拼接缝隙用净图的平滑背景填补（1467 / 9553 像素），更大的缺口（0 / 0 像素）用下一层。
missing: 底图 [O III] 与 [S II]（南天没有定标的窄带巡天）
船底座 [O III] 与 [S II]（没有定标数据，按 0 处理）
sources: SHASSA (Gaustad et al. 2001, PASP 113, 1326), continuum-subtracted Hα in deci-Rayleigh, ~0.8′; via CDS hips2fits (ov-gso/P/SHASSA)
